captions.caption: A person uses a knife to cut a thin slice of raw meat hanging from a branch.
The person continues slicing through the piece of meat with a sharp knife.
The hand holds the bottom of the meat while the knife finishes the cut.
A slice of meat is completely detached and held by the person.
The person places the slice of meat into a wooden bowl containing other slices.
The knife is repositioned to start another cut on the hanging meat.
The person carefully slices another piece of meat from the larger chunk.
The knife moves downward through the meat fibers.
Another thin slice of meat is being separated from the hanging portion.
The person holds the slice steady as the knife completes the cut.
The newly cut slice of meat is pulled away from the branch.
The slice of meat is added to the collection in the bowl.
The person reaches back towards the hanging meat to continue the process.
Hands are shown manipulating the raw meat in the wooden bowl.
The person finishes gathering the meat slices in the bowl.
A small metal stove is seen with a bright fire burning inside.
Flames and glowing embers are visible through the stove's opening.
The fire burns steadily, consuming the wood inside the stove.
A hand reaches in to add several small sticks to the fire.
The new wood is pushed into the center of the burning stove.
More thin branches are fed into the flames by the person.
The fire flares up slightly as the new fuel catches.
Another handful of twigs is added to the wood-burning stove.
The hand retracts after placing the sticks into the fire.
The fire continues to burn brightly, providing heat for cooking.
Close-up of the intense flames inside the black metal stove.
A pan of cooked meat, peppers, and bean sprouts is shown sizzling.
Steam rises from the hot, dark-colored mixture in the pan.
The ingredients are well-coated in a savory-looking sauce.
Bubbles from the sauce are visible as the food cooks.
The pan is filled with a variety of cooked vegetables and meat.
The camera remains focused on the appetizing dish in the pan.
The sizzling sound of the cooking food is emphasized by the visual.
A person uses a wooden spatula to stir or scoop the food.
The person begins transferring the cooked meal into a wooden bowl.
Large pieces of meat and sprouts are moved from the pan.
The bowl is being filled with the freshly cooked outdoor meal.
The person scrapes the remaining food from the pan into the bowl.
The wooden spatula helps guide the last bits of the dish.
The person finishes filling the bowl and sets the pan aside.
The full bowl of steaming food is ready to be eaten.
A man with long hair sits at the tent opening with the bowl.
He takes a large spoonful of the food and brings it to his mouth.
The man eats the food while sitting in front of his tent.
He chews the meal while looking out at the surroundings.
The man takes another bite of the cooked meat and vegetables.
He continues to enjoy his meal in the quiet forest setting.
The man looks down into the bowl as he scoops more food.
He pauses between bites, looking relaxed in the outdoors.
The man finishes another mouthful of the hot meal.
The man is seen sitting by his green tent in a wide shot.
He leans over to pick something up from the ground nearby.
The man stands up and turns away from the tent entrance.
He walks towards the side of the tent, carrying a small object.
The man examines the object in his hands while walking.
He continues walking away from the camera into the trees.
The man moves further into the campsite area behind the tent.
He disappears from view as he walks around the back of the tent.
The green tent and the surrounding forest are shown in a still shot.
The peaceful campsite remains quiet as the video continues.
